events.name: Jasper wildfire
events.summary: A wildfire reached Jasper after residents and visitors evacuated. Reporting describes damage to the town and the firefighting response in Jasper National Park.

events.name: Valparaíso region fires
events.summary: Forest fires spread into populated areas in central Chile. The report describes affected neighborhoods, the emergency response and curfews around Viña del Mar.

events.name: Alexandroupolis–Evros fire
events.summary: The fire began on August 19 and continued for days across northeastern Greece. Reporting covers the response by Greek crews and other European firefighting teams.

events.name: Lahaina wildfire
events.summary: A wildfire swept through Lahaina on August 8. This report examines the warnings, communication failures and evacuation difficulties as the fire spread through the town.

events.name: Mallacoota bushfire
events.summary: Residents and holidaymakers sheltered on the foreshore as fire approached on New Year’s Eve. With roads cut off, naval vessels began evacuating people on January 3.

events.name: Camp Fire
events.summary: The Camp Fire began on November 8 and spread into Paradise. NASA documented the smoke plume and fire with satellite imagery; news photographs show damage in the community.
